parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description to add to the task execution.

parameters.name: LoopMode
parameters.description:
The loop mode. Valid values:
- Automatic (default): does not pause
- FirstBatchPause: pauses after the first batch
- EveryBatchPause: pauses after each batch

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The execution mode. Valid values:
- Automatic (default): automatic execution
- FailurePause: pauses on failure
- Debug: step-by-step execution

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: A JSON string that consists of a set of parameters. Default value: {}.

parameters.name: SafetyCheck
parameters.description:
The safety check mode. Valid values:

- Skip (default): This option indicates that the customer is aware of the risks and can execute any action without confirmation, regardless of the risk level. This option is valid only when `Mode=Automatic`.
- ConfirmEveryHighRiskAction: This option requires the customer to confirm each high-risk action. The customer can confirm or cancel by calling the **NotifyExecution** operation.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags to add to the task execution.

parameters.name: TemplateContent
parameters.description: The template content in JSON or YAML format. This is the same as the Content field in the CreateTemplate request parameters. If you specify this parameter, you can directly run the tasks defined in TemplateContent without creating a template first. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create a task execution.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: TemplateURL
parameters.description: The URL of the OOS template content stored in Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS). Only publicly readable URLs are supported. If you specify this parameter, you can directly create a task execution based on the template content stored at the TemplateURL without creating a template first. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create a task execution.

parameters.name: TemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version number. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version number is used by default.
